titleZh: 教师主观幸福感问卷（TSWQ，中文工作稿）

items.originalEnglish: I feel like I belong at this school.
items.workingChinese: 我觉得自己属于这所学校。

items.originalEnglish: I can really be myself at this school.
items.workingChinese: 在这所学校，我能够真正做自己。

items.originalEnglish: I am good at helping students learn new things.
items.workingChinese: 我善于帮助学生学习新的东西。

items.originalEnglish: I feel like people at this school care about me.
items.workingChinese: 我觉得这所学校的人关心我。

items.originalEnglish: I have accomplished a lot as a teacher.
items.workingChinese: 作为教师，我已经取得了不少成就。

items.originalEnglish: I am treated with respect at this school.
items.workingChinese: 在这所学校，我受到尊重。

items.originalEnglish: I feel like my teaching is effective and helpful.
items.workingChinese: 我觉得自己的教学是有效而且有帮助的。

scores.label: Teacher Subjective Wellbeing
scores.description: Composite sum of all eight TSWQ items.

existingEvidenceForVerification.population: US elementary and middle school teachers
existingEvidenceForVerification.studyDesign: Initial instrument development; exploratory psychometric analyses, internal consistency, convergent/divergent validity, plus a smaller target teacher sample.
existingEvidenceForVerification.citation: Renshaw TL, Long ACJ, Cook CR. (2015). Assessing teachers' positive psychological functioning at work: Development and validation of the Teacher Subjective Wellbeing Questionnaire. School Psychology Quarterly, 30(2), 289–306.
existingEvidenceForVerification.notes: Original development supports a two-factor structure: school connectedness and teaching efficacy.

existingEvidenceForVerification.population: US teachers across elementary, middle, and high school settings
existingEvidenceForVerification.studyDesign: Confirmatory factor analysis and measurement invariance analyses across teacher/school groups.
existingEvidenceForVerification.citation: Mankin A, von der Embse N, Renshaw TL, Ryan SV. (2018). Assessing Teacher Wellness: Confirmatory Factor Analysis and Measurement Invariance of the Teacher Subjective Wellbeing Questionnaire. Journal of Psychoeducational Assessment, 36(3), 219–232.

existingEvidenceForVerification.population: Teachers from 56 middle schools across nine provinces in mainland China
existingEvidenceForVerification.studyDesign: Chinese revision validation with CFA, reliability, criterion associations, one-month retest subsample, and invariance across gender and teaching stages.
existingEvidenceForVerification.citation: Xie et al. (2024). Chinese revision of the Teacher Subjective Wellbeing Questionnaire. Chinese Journal of Clinical Psychology.
existingEvidenceForVerification.notes: Evidence supports a Chinese revision, but the exact Chinese item wording is not included in this English executable and must be separately source-verified before any zh-CN package is authored.

reportGeneral.title: 给自己的工作状态留一点观察空间
reportGeneral.limitation: 这是一份待人工审校的中文工作稿，不是临床诊断，不评价教师能力，不用于绩效问责、录用或学校排名。结果反映这次自述体验；中文分数不能自动与国外样本比较。
reportGeneral.invalid: 这部分回答不足，暂时不能形成可靠结果。你可以补充作答，也可以保留空白；缺失不等于没有困难。
reportGeneral.reading: 读报告先看两个生活主题，而不是找“及格线”。如展示平均回答，只用原选项频率作说明，不给好老师/差老师标签。

administration.instructionsEnglish: Below are some questions about your experiences as a teacher. Read each sentence and choose the one response that best describes how you felt in the past month.
administration.instructionsZh: 下面是一些关于你作为教师的经历的问题。请阅读每句话，选择最能描述你在过去一个月中感受的选项。

scoringNotes.missing: Author guide does not specify missing-value imputation; complete_required is explicit conservative implementation, not author-derived rule. Invalid means unavailable, notzero.
scoringNotes.optionalDerivedMean: Author explicitly permits sum/itemcount for response-anchor interpretation. If adding mean as separate score, mark derived, preserve canonical sum; no arbitrary low/moderate/high categories.

externalReferenceDossier.developmentPopulation: 2015 two samples:185elementary/middle school teachers;21elementary teachers experiencing classroom-management challenges. Not Chinese calibration or national norms.
externalReferenceDossier.guideStatement: 2020 guide explicitly says no large-scale national/regional/local normative data are available.
externalReferenceDossier.interpretation: Response-anchored means only: exact2 corresponds sometimes;3.5 lies between often/almostalways. This is an average subjective experience, not teacher effectiveness observed by others.

school_connectedness.title: 在学校有没有“自己人”的感觉
school_connectedness.meaning: 这里关注你是否觉得被接纳、被关心、被尊重，以及能否自在地做自己。它不是受欢迎程度排名。
school_connectedness.reflection: 在学校里，谁或哪种场景最让你感到被支持？还有哪种支持你希望获得？
school_connectedness.action: 选一位可信同事，从一次简短交流开始，具体说说最近需要什么帮助。

teaching_efficacy.title: 你对自己教学的信心与成就感
teaching_efficacy.meaning: 这里记录的是你自己感受到的教学信心与成就，不是对实际教学质量的考试。忙碌时期信心变化也很常见。
teaching_efficacy.reflection: 过去一个月，有没有一个学生理解了新内容、一次互动更顺畅的小片段？
teaching_efficacy.action: 记下一件具体有效的小做法，下周有机会再试一次；需要时与同伴讨论教学支持。

teacher_subjective_wellbeing.title: 这个月的教师生活，感觉怎么样
teacher_subjective_wellbeing.meaning: 把归属感与教学信心放在一起，帮助你回顾这个月的工作体验。两部分值得分别看，不能只用一个数字定义自己。
teacher_subjective_wellbeing.reflection: 你更想先改善支持感，还是找回教学中的小成就？
teacher_subjective_wellbeing.action: 只选一个可以改变的小环节，过一段时间再回顾它对自己的影响。
